figurative_meaning_en: Theoretical or bookish knowledge that is impractical in real life
similar_in_english: Book smart but not street smart
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পুঁথিগত বিদ্যা বাস্তবে কোনো কাজে আসে না।
পুঁথিগত বিদ্যা দিয়ে জীবনের সমস্যা সমাধান করা যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His bookish knowledge doesn't help in practical situations.
You can't solve real-life problems with just theoretical learning.
note: Refers to knowledge from scriptures or books that lacks practical application, common in Bengali proverbial wisdom.
